rendered: The table's Section row for Low-Co/Ni-Rich cathodes names Section 6 – Low-Co/Ni-Rich Cathodes (i.e. NMC 811[1]. In the ORNL study the paper describes, this NMC 811[2] cathode kept 80%[3] of its capacity at a 6C charging rate[4], while the corresponding NMC 532[5] and NMC 622[6] cathodes retained only 49%[7] and 56%[8] capacity, respectively, at the same rate. The NMC 811[9] areal loading was 2.2 mA h/cm^2[10] versus 2.4 mA h/cm^2[11] for the NMC 532[12] and NMC 622[13] cathodes.
